description: One privacy-minimized telemetry event as it leaves the device for scenario D5 (remote-access scam). These are the ONLY fields the SDK emits - there is no device id, IP, advertising id, or raw PII. risk_bits is already in the server layout; risk_signals is its stable name view. This is the canonical contract enforced by siem.canonicalFields.
notes: install_key_hash is a salted, tenant-scoped HMAC of the install key - it cannot be linked back to a person or correlated across tenants. coarse_time_bucket is unix seconds floored to the hour (1781582400 = 2026-06-16T04:00:00Z) for k-anonymity. country_or_region is optional and only present when the tenant's privacy policy permits coarse geography.
